free_text: It must be substantiated by tests, analysis or a combination thereof that the Engine Control System performs the intended functions in a manner which enables selected values of relevant control parameters to be maintained.

ears_text: The Engine Control System shall allow modulation of Engine power or thrust with adequate sensitivity and accuracy over the declared range of Engine operating conditions.
master_text: The Engine Control System shall be able to modulate the Engine power or thrust with adequate sensitivity and accuracy over the declared range of Engine operating conditions.

free_text: It must be substantiated by tests, analysis or a combination thereof that the Engine Control System performs the intended functions in a manner which does not create unacceptable thrust or power oscillations.

master_text: The Engine Control System shall not create unacceptable thrust or power oscillations.

free_text: It must be demonstrated that, when a Fault or Failure results in a change from one Control Mode to another, or from one channel to another, or from the Primary System to the Back-up System, the change occurs so that the Engine does not exceed any of its operating limitations.
ears_text: If a Fault or Failure results in a change from one Control Mode to another, or from one channel to another, or from the Primary System to the Back-up System, then the Engine Control System shall maintain the engine within its operating limitations.
master_text: As soon as a Fault or Failure results in a change from one Control Mode to another, or from one channel to another, or from the Primary System to the Back-up System, the Engine Control System shall maintain the engine within operating limits.

free_text: It must be demonstrated that, when a Fault or Failure results in a change from one Control Mode to another, or from one channel to another, or from the Primary System to the Back-up System, the change occurs so that the Engine does not surge, stall, flame-out or experience unacceptable thrust or power changes or oscillations, or other unacceptable characteristics.
ears_text: If a Fault or Failure results in a change from one Control Mode to another, or from one channel to another, or from the Primary System to the Back-up System, then the Engine Control System shall prevent the engine from surge, stall, flame-out or unacceptable thrust or power changes or oscillations, or other unacceptable characteristics.
master_text: As soon as a Fault or Failure results in a change from one Control Mode to another, or from one channel to another, or from the Primary System to the Back-up System, the Engine Control System shall prevent the engine from unacceptable characteristics.

free_text: It must be demonstrated that, when a Fault or Failure results in a change from one Control Mode to another, or from one channel to another, or from the Primary System to the Back-up System, the change occurs so that, if the flight crew is required to initiate, respond to or be aware of the Control Mode change, there must be provision for a means to alert the crew.
ears_text: If the flight crew is required to initiate, respond to or be aware of a Control Mode change and a Fault or Failure results in a change from one Control Mode to another, or from one channel to another, or from the Primary System to the Back-up System, then the Engine Control System shall provide provision for a means to alert the crew.
master_text: As soon as a Fault or Failure results in a change from one Control Mode to another, or from one channel to another, or from the Primary System to the Back-up System and the flight crew is required to initiate, respond to or be aware of the Control Mode change, the Engine Control System shall be able to alert the crew.

free_text: The magnitude of any change in thrust or power and the associated transition time must be identified and described in the Engine instructions for installation and operation.
ears_text: The Engine Control System shall provide a description of the magnitude of any change in thrust or power and the associated transition time to the Engine instructions for installation and operation.
master_text: The DOA shall describe the associated transition time of any change in thrust or power in the Engine instructions for installation and operation.

free_text: The Engine Control System must be designed and constructed so that the rate for Loss of Thrust (or Power) Control (LOTC/LOPC) events, consistent with the safety objective associated with the intended aircraft application, can be achieved.
ears_text: The Engine Control System shall achieve the rate for Loss of Thrust (or Power) Control (LOTC/LOPC) events, consistent with the safety objective associated with the intended aircraft application.
master_text: The Engine Control System shall achieve the rate for Loss of Thrust (or Power) Control (LOTC/LOPC) events consistent with the safety objective associated with the intended aircraft application.

free_text: The Engine Control System must be designed and constructed so that in the Full-up Configuration, the system is essentially single Fault tolerant for electrical and electronic Failures with respect to LOTC/LOPC events.
ears_text: While in Full-Up Configuration, the Engine Control System shall be essentially Single Fault Tolerant for electrical and electronic Failures with respect to LOTC/LOPC event.
master_text: As long as in full-up configuration, the Engine Control System shall be essentially single Fault tolerant for electrical and electronic Failures with respect to LOTC/LOPC events.

free_text: The Engine Control System must be designed and constructed so that Single Failures of Engine Control System components do not result in a Hazardous Engine Effect.
ears_text: If a single Failure of Engine Control System component occurs, then the Engine Control System shall not cause a Hazardous Engine Effect.
master_text: As soon as Single Failures of Engine Control System components occurs, the Engine Control System shall prevent a Hazardous Engine Effect.

free_text: The Engine Control System must be designed and constructed so that foreseeable Failures or malfunctions leading to local events in the intended aircraft installation, such as fire, overheat, or Failures leading to damage to Engine Control System components, must not result in a Hazardous Engine Effect due to Engine Control System Failures or malfunctions.
ears_text: If a foreseeable Failures or malfunction leads to local events in the intended aircraft installation or damage to Engine Control System components, then the Engine Control System shall not cause a Hazardous Engine Effect.
master_text: The Engine Control System shall be designed in a way that, as soon as foreseeable Failures or malfunctions lead to local events in the intended aircraft installation or damage to Engine Control System components, the engine can be operated without a Hazardous Engine Effect.

free_text: When complying with CS-E 210 or CS-E 510, a system safety assessment must be completed for the Engine Control System. master_text: As soon as the system safety assessment identifies faults or failures, the system safety assessment shall identify the predicted frequency of occurrence of these Faults or Failures.

free_text: When electronic over-speed protection systems are provided, the design must include a means for testing the system to establish the A13:A15 availability of the protection function. master_text: If a navigation function is necessary for the mission, the AOCS shall be able to determine the spacecraft orbital state.

free_text: The AOCS shall ensure that the attitude guidance and pointing specified by the mission requirements, during the mission operational phase are met.
